query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transformation_recipe_impacts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  transformation_id INT NOT NULL,
  recette_id INT NOT NULL,
  impact_type ENUM('major', 'moderate', 'minor', 'trace') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'moderate',
  impact_description TEXT,
  olfactory_contribution TEXT,
  percentage_contribution DECIMAL(5,2),
  temperature_range VARCHAR(100),
  notes TEXT,
  source_reference TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (transformation_id) REFERENCES molecular_transformations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (recette_id) REFERENCES recettes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_transformation_recipe (transformation_id, recette_id)
);
